# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: As per 秋# (shrunken) + 心 heart/emotions → feelings of a shrunken heart → *anxiety* → *change of countenance*. Compare and contrast 愁, which repositions the 心 element.
As per 秋# (shrunken) + 心 heart/emotions → *anxiety* (← feelings of a shrunken heart; compare 愀) → *sorrow*; *grief*; *lamentation*; *distress*.
憂也。从心秋聲。
As per 宣# (circle about) + 心 heart/emotions → *magnanimous* (← warm generosity that encompasses others).
寬嫺心腹皃。从心宣聲。《詩》曰：“赫兮愃兮。”
衍# overflow + 心 heart/emotions → *error*/*mistake* committed due to overflowing emotion → *fault*; *offense*; *transgression*.
過也。从心衍聲。
兪# remove + 心 heart/emotions → remove an (emotional) illness → *recover*. *More and more* and *surpassing/outstanding* are borrowed meanings.
兪# remove + 心 heart/emotions → remove unpleasant feelings from the heart → *pleasure*; *happiness*.
薄也。从心俞聲。《論語》曰：“私覿，愉愉如也。”
誠志也。从心畐聲。
As per 敃# (remove) + 心 heart/emotions → remove another person's anxieties → *compassion*; *sympathy*; *worry*. Compare 閔 and 憫.
痛也。从心敃聲。
As per 复# as described in 腹 (double back) + 心 heart/emotions → figurative doubling back in attitude → *defiance*; *stubborn*; *perverse*; *not conform with/to*.
As per 音# (contained) + 心 heart/emotions → keep contained in the heart (compare 念) → (deep) *thought*; *mind*; *signification*.
志也。从心察言而知意也。从心从音。
勉也。从心面聲。
As per 曷# (cut off) + 心 heart/emotions → have one's source of vitality cut off and *stop* to *rest* (compare 歇). *Threaten* is a borrowed meaning, via 喝.
息也。从心曷聲。
昜# rise + 心 heart/emotions → *self-indulgent* (← unrestrained attitude ← soaring emotion). Compare 慆.
放也。从心昜聲。一曰平也。
As per 咢# (cross, especially, cross over, or back and forth) + 心 heart/emotions → feeling of *surprise/astonishment* when events develop contrary to expectations → *be flustered*; *panic*.
敬也。从心客聲。《春秋傳》曰：“以陳備三愙。”
As per 禺# (curve) + 心 heart/emotions → warped (← curved) mind → *hardheaded*; *stupid*; *foolish*; *silly*.
戇也。从心从禺。禺，猴屬，獸之愚者。
The relevant seal inscription form combines a variant form of 既# (engorgement) + 心 heart/emotions → be emotionally hindered, in the sense of feeling overladen/dragged down → *love*.
行皃。从夊㤅聲。

匧# combines 夾 (be pressed between) + 匚 enclosure → contents tightly pressed into a container. Compare 匣. 愜 adds 心 heart/emotions → heart filled with contentment/satisfaction → *be satisfied*; *be comfortable*.
咸# (shut) + 心 heart/emotions → *emotion/feeling* that shuts off sensation (= moves/affects one to the point of muteness or immobility).
動人心也。从心咸聲。
As per 鬼# (large and lumpy) + 心 heart/emotions → *shame*; *ashamed* (← misshapen emotions).
An abbreviated form# of 殼 (hard husk) + 心 heart/emotions → hard, tightly united bonds → *sincere*; *earnest*.
謹也。从心𣪊聲。
憂皃。从心員聲。
As per 朔# (conjunction of beginning and end points) + 心 heart/emotions → *complain*; *accuse*; *sue* (← measures taken to restore original conditions).
懼也。从心，雙省聲。《春秋傳》曰：“駟氏愯。”
As per 倉# (pile) + 心 heart/emotions → *sorrowful* (← heart filled with sorrow) → *sad*.
傷也。从心倉聲。
憂皃。从心弱聲。讀與惄同。
As per 豈# (pile of food) + 心 heart/emotions → *enjoy oneself*; *be joyful* (← enjoy a feast; compare 凱). *High-spirited celebration* (of victory in war) is a borrowed meaning.
康也。从心、豈，豈亦聲。
樂也。从心豈聲。
順也。从心孫聲。《唐書》曰：“五品不愻。”
As per 眞# (fullness) + 心 heart/emotions → full attentiveness/*care* → *discretion*; *prudence*; *modesty*; *self-control*; *restraint* → *refrain/abstain* (from).
謹也。从心眞聲。
As per 氣# (rising vapors) + 心 heart/emotions → *anger* rising in the heart → *lament* (← another strong emotion that wells in the breast).
大息也。从心从氣，氣亦聲。《詩》曰：“愾我寤歎。”
原 here an abbreviated form# of 願 (notion that circulates persistently in the brain) + 心 heart/emotions → (overly) serious → *honest*; *sober*.
謹也。从心原聲。

願.explanation: 願 is the normal traditional form for wishing, desiring or being willing; 愿 may survive as a distinct literary character meaning honest/cautious.
願.usageCaveat: The 2013 table lists 願 as the traditional counterpart; uncommon inherited use of 愿 should not be automatically converted.
願.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: Abbreviated form# of 溷 muddy + 心 heart/emotions → have one's honor muddied/defiled → *dishonor*; *defile*. *Throw/be thrown into confusion* is a borrowed meaning via 溷.
憂也。从心圂聲。一曰擾也。
As per 栗# (sting) + 心 heart/emotions → *shiver*, *shudder* or *tremble* on account of *fear*, likened to a stinging emotion.
蚤# scratch + 心 heart/emotions → *agitation*; *anxiety* (← figurative scratching of the heart).
動也。从心蚤聲。一曰起也。
舀 here an abbreviated form# of 滔 (overflow) + 心 heart/emotions → heart overflowing with *pleasure* → *self-indulgent* (← pleasure taken too far). For "self-indulgent," compare 愓.
說也。从心舀聲。
As per 殷# (abundant) + 心 heart/emotions → demonstrate abundant concern/regard for others → *attentiveness*; *courtesy*. Compare 懃.
痛也。从心殷聲。
Abbreviated form# of 孳 bear children + 心 heart/emotions → parental *love/affection* for growing children → *tenderness*; *compassion*.
愛也。从心兹聲。
起也。从心畜聲。《詩》曰：“能不我慉。”

As per the previous form of 兼# (gather then put/store away) + 心 heart/emotions. 慊 bears contradictory meanings: *dissatisfied/unsatisfactory* and *satisfied/satisfactory*. The distinction owes to the quantity and/or quality of that which one has stored away, and whether one is content with the situation or not.
疑也。从心兼聲。

As per 能# (bear) + 心 heart/emotions → bear-like attribute(s) → *attitude*; *condition* (← state of mind or circumstances involving the bear-like attributes in question). *Keep up appearances* is a borrowed meaning.
意也。从心从能。
荒# wild + 心 heart/emotions → wild state of mind → *be confused/flustered*; *be agitated*; *panic* → *busy*; *hurried*; *rushed*; *bustling*.
As per 𥁕# as described in 温 (hold in/down) + 心 heart/emotions → *grudge*/anger held in the heart → *get angry*. Compare 怨.
怒也。从心𥁕聲。
慮也。从心曹聲。
As per 票# (light) + 心 heart/emotions → (emotionally) *light* or *airy* → *agile*. Compare 僄.
疾也。从心票聲。
勉也。从心莫聲。

As per 莫# (concealed) + 心 heart/emotions → yearn for something concealed, or not at hand → *yearning* → *admiration*; *adoration* → *dear to one*; *love*. Also, *follow* (← follow the object of one's adoration).
As per 參# (commingle) + 心 heart/emotions → mixed, painful emotions → *pain*; *misery*; *piteous*; *wretched*.
毒也。从心參聲。
As per 斬# (cut) + 心 heart/emotions → feel as though one's heart has been cut → *feel ashamed*; *shame*. For other types of emotional pain among cognate terms in Old Chinese, compare 慘 and 懺.
媿也。从心斬聲。
匿# hide/conceal + 心 heart/emotions → *hidden evil*; *evil deed committed in secret* → *evil*; *bad*.
As per 動# (run through) + 心 heart/emotions → *grieve* as though one is being run through → *wail*.
大哭也。从心動聲。
As per 曼# (cover/be covered) + 心 heart/emotions → *sloth* (← heart figuratively covered by dullness) → *slow*; *idle*; *lazy*. *Conceitedness* and *boastfulness* are borrowed meanings.
惰也。从心曼聲。一曰慢，不畏也。

貫# penetrate; go through + 心 heart/emotions → condition created by going through an action/activity to the point of thorough penetration → *become/make accustomed to* → *train*; *exercise*; *custom* → *become skillful*.

造# build/make + 心 heart/emotions. The original signification is unclear, but likely had something to do with anxiety, grief or another state involving shriveled emotions; compare the Old Chinese cognates 愀 慅 憔 悄 懆 and 愁. In Japanese, 慥 conveys the meanings *devise/contrive/think up* (an idea, particularly, in a hurry) along with *certainly* and *likely*.
彗# comet (→ bright object) + 心 heart/emotions → *bright*; *intelligent*; *wise* (← intelligence likened to a bright comet within the mind).
儇也。从心彗聲。
As per 既# (engorged) + 心 heart/emotions → heart engorged with sadness → *lament*; *regret*; *deplore*.
忼慨，壯士不得志也。从心旣聲。
從# follow + 心 heart/emotions → compliant state of mind → *advise*; *persuade* (← advise/persuade another person to comply).
心 heart/emotions + an abbreviated form# of 盧 (sunken) → be sunk in finely detailed thoughts (compare 思) → *consider*; *ponder*; *be concerned about*.
謀思也。从思虍聲。
憂也。从心，殤省聲。

As per 尉# (bending figure that is branded) + 心 heart/emotions → *comfort*/*console* a person who has been branded (= a person who is suffering) → *cheer up* → *relief*; *hobby*; *amusement*; *diversion*; *pastime*; *make sport of*. For the idea of comforting a suffering person, compare 恤.
安也。从心尉聲。一曰恚怒也。
忘也。慲兜也。从心㒼聲。
As per 堅# (adhere) + 心 heart/emotions → emotional adherence to possessions → *stingy*, *miserly*.
As per 習# (press flat) + 心 heart/emotions → breast constricted with *fear* → *be frightened*. Compare 懾.
懼也。从心習聲。讀若疊。
庸# work + 心 heart/emotions → feel lethargic following work → *indolent*; *lazy*.
嬾也。从心庸聲。
An abbreviated form# of 愛 (dragged down) + an abbreviated form of 鹿 deer → celebrate the dragging down/capture of a deer → *felicitation*; *congratulations*; *blessing*.
行賀人也。从心从夂。吉禮以鹿皮爲贄，故从鹿省。
As per 康# (firm and taut) + 心 heart/emotions → taut emotions → *impassioned*.
高也。一曰極也。一曰困劣也。从心帶聲。
悑也。从心執聲。
憂也。从心戚聲。
欲# desire; greed + 心 heart/emotions (for emphasis/clarification) → *desire*; *greed*; *lust*; *passion*.
憀然也。从心翏聲。

The relevant seal inscription form is an element combining 頁 head and 心 heart/emotions + 夊 here an abbreviated form# of 後 (drag along) → pensive, dragging state of mind, causing deliberate movement (compare 愛) → *sadness*; *anxiety*; *worry*; *grief*; *disappointment*; *depression*.
和之行也。从夊𢚧聲。《詩》曰：“布政憂憂。”
舂# pound + 心 heart/emotions → be rendered insensible by pounding → *dull*; *foolish* (compare 檮). Compare also the graphically similar and phonetically close 惷.
愚也。从心舂聲。
心 heart/emotions + 備# for the sound alone to simulate panting or labored breathing → *fatigue*/*exhaustion*.
憂也。从心鈞聲。
Originally as per 曾# (pile) + 心 heart/emotions → emotions that pile upon each other, in the form of hatred, detestation etc. → *hate*; *detest*; *loathe* → *animosity*; *be jealous*.
惡也。从心曾聲。
As per 粦# as described in 隣 (repeated series) + 心 heart/emotions → waves of *sympathy* (compare 怜) → *pity*. Also, *treasure* and *dote on*.
哀也。从心粦聲。
Abbreviated form# of 凴 lean on + 心 heart/emotions → *lean/depend on* (emotionally). *Proof* is another meaning carried over from 凴. Also, the borrowed meaning *haunt/possess*.
As per 貴# (compress) + 心 heart/emotions → heart in a reduced state → *be confused*.
亂也。从心貴聲。
As per 焦# (shrink) + 心 heart/emotions → emotional state causing one to *grow thin/haggard*.
平也。从心登聲。
問也。謹敬也。从心猌聲。一曰說也。一曰甘也。《春秋傳》曰：“昊天不憖。”又曰：“兩君之士皆未憖。”
喜# joy + 心 heart/emotions (for emphasis/clarification) → *joy*; *gladness*; *happiness*.
說也。从心从喜，喜亦聲。

As per 單# (fanning motion) + 心 heart/emotions → heart palpitating (= fanning motion) with *fear* → *dread*; *shrink from*; *refrain from*; *hesitate*; *be reserved* (← be fearful of doing). Also, *awe* (← dread).
忌難也。从心單聲。一曰難也。
不敬也。从心，𡐦省。《春秋傳》曰：“執玉憜。”
As per 敦# (swarm) + 心 heart/emotions → heart swarming with hatred → *hate*. Compare 譈.
怨也。从心敦聲。《周書》曰：“凡民罔不憝。”
As per 賁# (swell) + 心 heart/emotions → swelling emotion, in the form of *wrath*, *anger*, *rage*, *indignation* or *resentment*.
懣也。从心賁聲。
As per 童# (run through) + 心 heart/emotions → be figuratively run through with *yearning* → *aspiration*; *longing for*; *admiration* (← yearning for an object or trait one does not possess).
意不定也。从心童聲。
As per 敢# (covered) + 心 heart/emotions → *foolish* (← keep one's knowledge/intentions covered, causing one to appear foolish). For the idea of failing to articulate one's ideas, compare 感.
舌# speaking + 息 breath → take a breather from speech → *rest*; *relaxation*.
愉也。从心閒聲。
閔# mourn; sympathize; pity + 心 heart/emotions (for emphasis/clarification) → *mourn*; *sympathize*; *pity*. Compare 愍.
As per 景# (expansive) + 心 heart/emotions → expansive longing → *long for*.
覺寤也。从心景聲。《詩》曰：“憬彼淮夷。”
慧也。从心尞聲。
As per 無# (concealed) + 心 heart/emotions → concealed feelings of *disappointment*.
愛也。韓鄭曰憮。一曰不動。从心無聲。
痛也。从心朁聲。
權詐也。从心矞聲。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form is an abbreviated form# of 害 (cut) + 目 eye → (full/partial) cutting off of vision (compare 瞎). A seal inscription form adds 心 heart/emotions to suggest the (full/partial) cutting off of one's desires as well → *law* (← create the rule of law by restricting desires; compare 律, 埒, 法 and 笵) → *constitution*.
敏也。从心从目，害省聲。
As per 意# (contained in the heart) + 心 heart/emotions → various thoughts contained in the heart → *think*; *remember*.
As per 僉# (assemble) + 心 heart/emotions → *crafty* assemblage of words designed to captivate another person's heart → *flatter*.
憸詖也。憸利於上，佞人也。从心僉聲。
As per 詹# (bear a burden) + 心 heart/emotions → bear anxiety and maintain a *calm* front.
安也。从心詹聲。
敬也。从心从敬，敬亦聲。
As per 感# (shut off sensation) + 心 heart/emotions → heart figuratively shut off/down by *regret*.
幸也。从心敫聲。
As per 睘# as described in 環 (circular) + 心 heart/emotions → swirling emotions → *restless*; *anxious*.
急也。从心瞏聲。讀若絹。
勤# diligent + 心 heart → be diligent in attending to another person's needs (compare 慇) → *solicitous*; *courteous*; *polite*.
As per 喿# as described in 操 (activity taking place above) + 心 heart/emotions → apprehension weighing on the heart → *anxiety*; *become uneasy*.
愁不安也。从心喿聲。《詩》曰：“念子懆懆。”
As per 貇# as described in 墾 (adhere) + 心 heart/emotions → adhering/lasting feelings of *cordiality* or *sincerity* (compare 恩) → *courteous*; *intimate*.
悃也。从心豤聲。
As per 解# (remove a protective element) + 心 heart/emotions → strip away tense/guarded emotions → *be relaxed*. Also, *laziness*.
怠也。从心解聲。

As per the top element# of 鷹 (trained bird of prey) + 心 heart/emotions → *accede* (as a trained bird accedes to commands) → *agree (to)* → *respond*; *reply*; *react*; *be fitting*; *be suited*. Also, *reward* and *return*.
當也。从心𤸰聲。
奧# deep + 心 heart/emotions → *deep anxiety*.
勉也。从心楙聲。《虞書》曰：“時惟懋哉。”
As per 睪# (align) + 心 heart/emotions → be relaxed/at ease (← heart in proper alignment) → *rejoice*.
說也。从心睪聲。經典通用釋。
Abbreviated form# of 凜 (shiver/tremble) + 心 heart/emotions → shiver/tremble in *fear* or *awe*. Also, *be anxious for another*.
厭# be satiated + 心 heart/emotions (for emphasis/clarification) → *be satiated* → *be content*.
安也。从心厭聲。《詩》曰：“懕懕夜飲。”
善自用之意也。从心銛聲。《商書》曰：“今汝懖懖。”
惉懘也。从心滞聲。
As per 夢# (obscure) + 心 heart/emotions → *absentminded*; *vacant*; *be at a loss* (← obscure emotional states).
不明也。从心夢聲。
騃也。从心从疑，疑亦聲。一曰惶也。
對# be in opposition + 心 heart/emotions → confrontational emotions → *resent*; (bear a) *grudge*; *envy*.
怨也。从心對聲。
As per 滿# (cover) + 心 heart/emotions → heart figuratively covered with *anger* → *agony*. Compare 悶.
煩也。从心从滿。
As per 需# (soft) + 心 heart/emotions → *weak-minded*; *timid*; *cowardly* (← soft-hearted).
駑弱者也。从心需聲。
闊也。一曰廣也，大也。一曰寬也。从心从廣，廣亦聲。
輕易也。从心蔑聲。《商書》曰：“以相陵懱。”
徴# summon + 心 heart/emotions → summon a subject for *reprimand*/chastisement→ *chastise*; *punish*; *teach someone a lesson* → *learn a lesson*; *learn from (bitter) experience*.
㣻也。从心徵聲。
As per 賴# (sharp reduction) + 心 heart/emotions → *lazy*; *languid* (← sharp reduction in energy) → *neglectful*.

The relevant bronzeware inscription form of 褱# shows a trail of round tears falling from an eye + 衣 clothing → trail of tears absorbed in one's garment → fall and be absorbed. 懷 adds 心 heart/emotions → warm feelings harbored in the heart/breast → *fondness*; *yearning/longing*; *breast/bosom/heart*; *be dear to one*; *miss* (someone); *win over*. Also, *breast pocket* and *purse*.
念思也。从心褱聲。

As per 縣# as described in 県 (hang suspended) + 心 heart/emotions → emotional state likened to hanging suspended → *hang* (suspended); *be undecided*; *be distant/apart* → *offer* (a prize) (← hold out an enticement at a tantalizing distance).
As per 韱# (slender/fine) + 心 heart/emotions → fine sensibility, in the form of *remorse* or *repentance*.
恐也。从心瞿聲。
As per 雚# as described in 勸 (circular uniformity) + 心 heart/emotions → *rejoice*, a number of voices crying out in unison (compare 讙). *Be anxious* is a borrowed meaning.
喜𠭥也。从心雚聲。《爾雅》曰：“懽懽愮愮，憂無告也。”
As per 聶# (press together) + 心 heart/emotions → *fear* pressing upon the breast → *be frightened*. Compare 慴.
失气也。从心聶聲。一曰服也。

Originally, as per 壹 (jar crammed full) + 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → partake of the fine contents of a full container → *full and fine*. 欠 morphed into 次 and 心 heart/emotions was added, causing the right-hand element to appear as the etymologically unrelated 恣. *Virtue* and *splendid deed* are via association with "full and fine."
專久而美也。从壹，从恣省聲。
